name: Yoru Bar
description: Yoru Bar - a theme for a reservation-only cocktail bar. A near-black ground (#0D0D0D) with a lifted ink-blue panel (#2A2C33), pure white and one tan accent (#B1A28B). The home page opens on a full-bleed low-key photograph framed by two big foreground objects with a centred moon ring that fades in, under a transparent overlay header with a vertical Menu between two hairlines and a bottom info bar; it continues with full-viewport split panels whose display word is struck by a hairline, three tall photograph strips, a circle photograph with an offset tan disc, a white wash section with a tile strip bleeding off both edges, a wide photograph straddling white and black with a twelve-seat arc and seating rows, and hairline notes rows. EB Garamond for reading, Work Sans for small labels. Sample content in English. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours.
